The '''RPC-12''' was an upgraded, shipboard version of a portable [[force cage]] produced by [[Damorind Securities]] known as a [[restraint capsule]]. It used multiple layers of low-level [[Force field/Legends|force fields]] with power regulators for an effective restraint system, but with minimal power requirements, minimizing any drain on a [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] power systems.
